description: React component for Nvidia NIM setup dialog, managing installation, image pulling, container starting, and existing container handling.

classes.name: NvidiaNIMDialog
classes.description: React functional component for Nvidia NIM setup dialog with multiple steps and API interactions.

methods.name: handleDownloadInstaller
methods.description: Downloads the Nvidia NIM installer via API.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Preloads Nvidia NIM resources via API.

methods.name: handlePullImage
methods.description: Pulls the specified image, with polling for status.

methods.name: handleStartContainer
methods.description: Starts a new container or uses an existing one, with polling for status.

methods.name: startNewContainer
methods.description: Initiates starting a new container and polls for its status.

methods.name: handleUseExistingContainer
methods.description: Uses an existing container and polls for its status.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Handles progression through dialog steps with validation.
